items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The transcript identifies Dr. Anthony Brown as the interviewer conducting the oral history. There is no mention of any prior personal or professional relationship between Branford Marsalis and Anthony Brown in the provided text.

ctx.x: Interviewer: Dr. Anthony Brown, engineered by Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, pp. 160

Today is May 24, 2012 and this is the Smithsonian Oral History Interview with saxophonist, composer, bandleader, educator, radio and TV personality and erstwhile thespian, or actor, NEA Jazz Master Branford Marsalis in his home in Durham, North Carolina. Good morning Mr. Marsalis, how are you doing?
